court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Dr. Prabhakar Bhagwan Satpute vs Shamita Sanjay Galwankar & Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Dr. Prabhakar Bhagwan Satpute, Executor named under the Will of the deceased
parties.respondent_defendant: Shamita Sanjay Galwankar and Geeta Ashok Samant

facts_of_case: Petitioner is a senior citizen who filed the petition in 2011. Caveats were filed later in 2013, when the petition was renumbered as a suit. The matter has been pending since April 2015.

legal_principles.principle: A testator's intention is to be gathered from the language used in the Will.
legal_principles.held: This is a matter of construction and the intention of the testator must be gathered from the language used in the Will.
cited_cases: Dr. Prabhakar Bhagwan Satpute vs Shamita Sanjay Galwankar & Anr, (2016)

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the person challenging the Will to prove that it does not reflect the testator's true intentions.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above, the burden lies on the respondents to prove that the Will does not reflect the testator's true intentions.
cited_cases: Dr. Prabhakar Bhagwan Satpute vs Shamita Sanjay Galwankar & Anr, (2016)

keywords: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
use_for_drafting: executing the will of a deceased person
